sources.title: Strong coupling expansion for Yang-Mills theory at finite temperature
sources.authors: Jens Langelage, Gernot Münster, Owe Philipsen
sources.authentication: PDF first page version and title/authors checked against arXiv metadata and official PoS publisher record.
sources.used_result: Wilson character expansion, c0 factor, connected closed-surface polymers, fundamental coefficient beta/18 at leading order. Their thermal subtraction discards zero-temperature pieces; our absolute logZ retains them.
sources.application_verdict: Verified for the explicitly declared Wilson normalization and formal local graph expansion. Inapplicable as physical S4 data. Matrix-index orthogonality is independently derived; no unspecified character normalization in the source is imported.

sources.title: Four-dimensional pure compact U(1) gauge theory on a spherical lattice
sources.authors: J. Jersak, C. B. Lang, T. Neuhaus
sources.authentication: Exact version PDF first page and arXiv metadata agree; journal Phys Rev D54 6909 (1996), doi 10.1103/PhysRevD.54.6909.
sources.used_result: SH[N] is the closed boundary of a 5D grid, distinct from weighted projected S[N]; exact cell counts with n=N-1. Curvature is concentrated on strata in SH[N]. Source w_p=A'_p/A_p seeks naive continuum metric matching but finite-beta distortions are explicitly allowed.
sources.application_verdict: Connectivity and cell counts verified after notation translation; independently enumerated in our calculation. U(1) transition data and continuum claims are inapplicable to SU(3) physical QCD.

sources.title: Scope and convergence of the hopping parameter expansion in finite temperature QCD with heavy quarks around the critical point
sources.authors: Naoki Wakabayashi, Shinji Ejiri, Kazuyuki Kanaya, Masakiyo Kitazawa
sources.authentication: PDF first page version and authors checked against exact arXiv submission metadata and publisher DOI.
sources.used_result: Flat Wilson M=1-kappa B, detM(0)=1, log determinant trace expansion; flat leading Wilson plaquette factor is not assigned to curved K_n.
sources.application_verdict: Algebraic determinant-normalization convention verified. Physical curved spinor action and light-quark/continuum transfer conditional and not implemented.
